about_the_game:
The Outlands spares no one! Armed with the Doomsday Raider Pack, rise as an unstoppable force and dominate these desolate lands. Secure supplies and show no mercy to anyone who crosses your path.

This pack includes:

  • Vindicator Uniform (Doomsday Raider) 

  • Brim Boonie Hat (Doomsday Raider)

  • Grim Mask (Doomsday Raider)

  • Sleek Pack (Doomsday Raider)

  • Vindicator Gloves (Doomsday Raider)

  • 10x Taiga 21 + 360x ammo (Combat Shell)

  • Nuclear Skin for Taiga 21

  • 10x Berry M12 + 960x ammo (9x19 Parabellum)

  • Toxic Sludge Skin for Berry M12

  • 10x L85A1 + 900x ammo (5.56x45 NATO)

  • CBRN Skin for L85A1

  • 10x Iodine

  • 10x Adrenaline Shot

  • 5x Armor Plate

  • 5x Radiation Grenade

  • 2x Double XP Ticket

  • 5x Insurance Ticket

  • 25x Loadout Ticket

  • 2000 Crowns

This pack may only be purchased once per account and is available for a limited time.
